scope: feature/1880-canary-alert-names vs origin/dev @39f29c64 (#1880 canary alert-surface parity)

findings.verifier: independent fresh-context agent, instructed to refute; executed real code with planted sentinels
findings.title: Canary alerts now disclose credential-incident location to a non-admin audience
findings.description: G-04 alerts previously rendered a count-only fallback. They now carry which agent and execution row hold a credential-shaped value, the matched credential family, and that the value is stored plaintext. The secret value itself is never sent and that property is regression-pinned.
findings.exploit_scenario: An observer with Slack access to the channel behind CANARY_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL - membership unrelated to the Trinity admin role - learns agent, execution id, credential family, and persistence from a fired G-04 alert, including via the text fallback that drives mobile push. Before #1880 the same reconnaissance required an admin query against canary_violations.
findings.impact: Risk transfer, not a new leak. Bounded: no secret value, no user content, no PII.
findings.recommendation: APPLIED IN-DIFF: architecture.md canary Alert-sink section now states what a rendered alert carries and requires CANARY_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL to point at a restricted channel. Documentation control; no code change - the disclosure is the feature's intent.

notes_below_bar.title: Render boundary performed no escaping (defense-in-depth)
notes_below_bar.detail: Injection safety is transitive across ~8 sanitize-at-write paths, all verified. Hard exclusion #5 (hardening without concrete vulnerability). A ~3-line render-boundary scrub would make it structural; this diff grew render sites from 10 to 15.
notes_below_bar.precedent: services/retention_guard.py writes a leading-underscore alarm sentinel the sanitizer could never produce; excluded from L-03's scan so unreachable today.
notes_below_bar.resolution: _mrkdwn_safe() added at the render boundary and applied to every string field interpolated from observed_state (56 call sites), collapsing the two inconsistent ?-defaulting idioms into one. Escapes &, <, > (Slack's documented set - the three that make a link or mention parse) and collapses control chars so a value cannot forge a bullet line. *, _, ~, backtick left alone: no Slack escape exists, cosmetic only, and mangling them corrupts legitimate values. Covered by test_hostile_identity_field_cannot_forge_slack_markup (6 payloads x 4 invariants) + test_mrkdwn_safe_contract; mutation-verified (removing the escape line fails 17 tests).

notes_below_bar.title: Behaviour change wider than the diff's framing
notes_below_bar.detail: Nine pre-existing _render_message branches now coerce a NULL agent_name to '?'. Previously TypeError in sorted() was swallowed and the alert silently dropped while the green-to-red cursor advanced. Those alerts now send - affects all 15 invariants, not only the 5 named.

notes_below_bar.title: _format_duration over-claimed its own guarantee
notes_below_bar.detail: Caught (TypeError, ValueError) while int(float('inf')) raises OverflowError, contradicting a docstring promising the helper can never be why an alert fails to send. Unreachable today; now caught.

verified_safe.claim: No credential material can reach the Slack payload
verified_safe.evidence: All 15 ViolationReport constructions read; no rendered field is backlog_metadata. reason/matched_pattern are module constants. No signal_query carries a secret either. Sentinels planted in observed_state reached neither text nor blocks.

JSON break-out structurally impossible (dict + httpx serialization). Eight agent-name write paths traced, all sanitized; rename is stricter. All other rendered fields server-generated. Confidence 8 not 9: guarantee is transitive, zero escaping at the render boundary (see N1). POST-FIX: confidence raised 8 -> 9 - N1 resolved, so the guarantee is no longer transitive across ~8 write paths; escaping is now local to the render boundary.

coverage_gaps: src/backend/enterprise submodule not checked out (update = none); enterprise agent-creation paths unaudited for unsanitized agent_name writes. Relevant only to N1.
Slack rendering not exercised against a live workspace; Block Kit limits asserted against documented caps at 5000 violations x 500 agents.
trend: Not comparable by fingerprint - every prior cso-diff report audited a different branch and scope. F1 is new because no prior report covered the canary alert path.
